summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.78/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.78 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 9, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 10¢ lower than a week ago, 32¢ higher than a month ago, and 97¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.59) and the highest in Superior ($4.03).
